title: Countable atlas of flattening charts on {y ∈ V : DF(y) ≠ 0} (inverse function theorem; parent step 2)
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ) (V : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), IsOpen V → ContDiff ℝ 1 F → ∃ (Ω : ℕ → Set (Euclid (n + 1))) (Θ : ℕ → Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid (n + 1)), (∀ k, IsOpen (Ω k) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (Θ k) (Ω k) ∧ InjOn (Θ k) (Ω k) ∧ (∀ z ∈ Ω k, Injective (fderiv ℝ (Θ k) z)) ∧ IsOpen (Θ k '' Ω k) ∧ Θ k '' Ω k ⊆ V ∧ ∀ z ∈ Ω k, F (Θ k z) = z 0) ∧ {y | y ∈ V ∧ fderiv ℝ F y ≠ 0} ⊆ ⋃ k, Θ k '' Ω k
